acceptanceCriteria: the Playwright producer retains registered route patterns with per-test hit counts (or records NOT_PRODUCED when it cannot)
test-validity reports stub-never-matched with pattern and registration line for a passing test with a zero-hit stub, and nothing when the stub was hit, with conformance vectors for both
spec rows recorded; the issue is closed with the PR
body: GitHub #948 (owner, build main-253d634). A page.route handler registered for a resource the app fetches server-side never runs, so the test passes on unmocked data while readers assume the mock fixes the input; in the reported case it hid an order-dependent assertion. The test-validity-v0 conformance vectors have no stub/route code today; #872 (V1-1366) covers inert negative controls only. Request: an optional producer-side record of each registered route pattern and its per-test hit count (behaviour-events / navigation-events producers could carry it), and a test-validity finding (e.g. stub-never-matched) for a passing test whose stub had zero hits, naming the pattern and the registration line. Stubs registered only on a control path stay out of scope.
title: test-validity: report a request stub (Playwright page.route/context.route) that never matched during a passing run (GitHub #948)
